findings.location:
Believe that God cares

…Say it. Read the Psalms over and over.…

and final paragraph with Psalmist reference
findings.source_quote: Read the Psalms over and over. … And say with the Psalmist, “In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion” (Psalm 71:1).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or transliterate the book name correctly. Replace "ভেসালের বই (Psalms)" and "ভেসালের লেখকের" with an accurate Bengali rendering such as "গীতসংহিতা (Psalms)" or simply "সঙ্গলীত/গীতসংহিতা" consistently. Keep the English Bible quotations exactly as in the source and preserve surrounding HTML tags.

findings.location: “I became alarmed when I heard him yawning in the middle of the night and knew that he was not sleeping.”

findings.translation_quote: আমি তখনই আশঙ্কিত হয়ে উঠলাম যখন শুনলাম সে মধ্যরাতে হাই হাই করছে এবং জানলাম সে ঘুমায় না।
